name: Eye Revenue on Hand
Eye Won Not Billed
report_script:
# Eye Won Not Billed: approved deals with nothing invoiced yet, oldest first.
flt = frappe.utils.flt
today = frappe.utils.nowdate()
rows = []
for d in frappe.get_all("Opportunity", filters={"sales_stage": "Quote approved"},
                        fields=["name", "customer_name", "currency", "custom_approved_on", "total", "opportunity_amount",
                                "custom_billed_amount", "custom_sales_order", "owner"]):
    if flt(d.custom_billed_amount) > 0:
        continue
    requested = sum([flt(b.total) for b in frappe.get_all("Billing Request", filters={"opportunity": d.name}, fields=["total"])])
    approved = str(d.custom_approved_on or "")[:10]
    rows.append({"opportunity": d.name, "customer_name": d.customer_name, "approved_on": approved or None,
                 "days": frappe.utils.date_diff(today, approved) if approved else None, "currency": d.currency,
                 "value": flt(d.total or d.opportunity_amount), "requested": requested, "sales_order": d.custom_sales_order,
                 "owner": d.owner})
rows = [r for dk, ik, r in sorted([(-(r["days"] or 0), i, r) for i, r in enumerate(rows)])]
columns = [
    {"fieldname": "opportunity", "label": _("Deal"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Opportunity", "width": 160},
    {"fieldname": "customer_name", "label": _("Customer"), "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200},
    {"fieldname": "approved_on", "label": _("Approved On"), "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "days", "label": _("Days Waiting"), "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 100},
    {"fieldname": "currency", "label": _("Currency"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Currency", "hidden": 1},
    {"fieldname": "value", "label": _("Deal Value"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 130},
    {"fieldname": "requested", "label": _("Requested"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 130},
    {"fieldname": "sales_order", "label": _("Sales Order"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Order", "width": 140},
    {"fieldname": "owner", "label": _("Sales"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "User", "width": 160},
]
data = columns, rows

name: Eye Billing Pipeline
Eye Collections
report_script:
# Eye Collections: invoiced against collected, by invoice month.
flt = frappe.utils.flt
cond = {"billing_stage": ["in", ["Invoiced", "Collected"]]}
if filters.get("from_date") and filters.get("to_date"):
    cond["invoice_date"] = ["between", [filters.get("from_date"), filters.get("to_date")]]
groups = {}
for b in frappe.get_all("Billing Request", filters=cond, fields=["invoice_date", "total", "collected_amount", "currency"]):
    key = (str(b.invoice_date or "")[:7], b.currency)
    g = groups.get(key) or {"count": 0, "invoiced": 0, "collected": 0}
    g["count"] = g["count"] + 1
    g["invoiced"] = g["invoiced"] + flt(b.total)
    g["collected"] = g["collected"] + flt(b.collected_amount)
    groups[key] = g
rows = []
for key in sorted(groups):
    g = groups[key]
    rows.append({"month": key[0], "currency": key[1], "invoices": g["count"], "invoiced": g["invoiced"],
                 "collected": g["collected"], "outstanding": g["invoiced"] - g["collected"]})
columns = [
    {"fieldname": "month", "label": _("Invoice Month"), "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "currency", "label": _("Currency"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Currency", "width": 80},
    {"fieldname": "invoices", "label": _("Invoices"), "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 90},
    {"fieldname": "invoiced", "label": _("Invoiced"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 140},
    {"fieldname": "collected", "label": _("Collected"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 140},
    {"fieldname": "outstanding", "label": _("Outstanding"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 140},
]
data = columns, rows

name: Eye Pricing Turnaround
report_script:
# Eye Pricing Turnaround: how long Production takes to price, and whether it met Required By.
rows = []
cond = {}
if filters.get("from_date") and filters.get("to_date"):
    cond["creation"] = ["between", [filters.get("from_date"), filters.get("to_date")]]
for p in frappe.get_all("Pricing Request", filters=cond, order_by="creation desc",
                        fields=["name", "opportunity", "customer_name", "creation", "required_by", "priced_on", "status"]):
    asked = str(p.creation)[:10]
    priced = str(p.priced_on or "")[:10]
    on_time = None
    if priced and p.required_by:
        on_time = 1 if priced <= str(p.required_by) else 0
    rows.append({"pricing_request": p.name, "opportunity": p.opportunity, "customer_name": p.customer_name,
                 "requested_on": asked, "required_by": p.required_by, "priced_on": priced or None,
                 "days": frappe.utils.date_diff(priced or frappe.utils.nowdate(), asked), "on_time": on_time, "status": p.status})
columns = [
    {"fieldname": "pricing_request", "label": _("Pricing Request"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Pricing Request", "width": 150},
    {"fieldname": "opportunity", "label": _("Deal"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Opportunity", "width": 150},
    {"fieldname": "customer_name", "label": _("Customer"), "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"fieldname": "requested_on", "label": _("Requested On"), "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "required_by", "label": _("Required By"), "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "priced_on", "label": _("Priced On"), "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "days", "label": _("Days"), "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 70},
    {"fieldname": "on_time", "label": _("On Time"), "fieldtype": "Check", "width": 80},
    {"fieldname": "status", "label": _("Status"), "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
]
data = columns, rows

name: Eye Deal PL
report_script:
# Eye Deal PL: cost, minimum selling, sold and invoiced for each won deal.
flt = frappe.utils.flt
rows = []
stages = ["Project Won", "Accounts, please approve", "Quote approved"]
for d in frappe.get_all("Opportunity", filters={"sales_stage": ["in", stages]},
                        fields=["name", "customer_name", "sales_stage", "currency", "custom_total_cost", "custom_total_selling",
                                "total", "opportunity_amount", "custom_billed_amount", "custom_collected_amount"]):
    cost = flt(d.custom_total_cost)
    sold = flt(d.total or d.opportunity_amount)
    gp = sold - cost
    rows.append({"opportunity": d.name, "customer_name": d.customer_name, "stage": d.sales_stage, "currency": d.currency,
                 "cost": cost, "minimum": flt(d.custom_total_selling), "sold": sold, "gross_profit": gp,
                 "gp_on_cost": (gp / cost * 100) if cost else 0, "invoiced": flt(d.custom_billed_amount),
                 "collected": flt(d.custom_collected_amount)})
columns = [
    {"fieldname": "opportunity", "label": _("Deal"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Opportunity", "width": 150},
    {"fieldname": "customer_name", "label": _("Customer"), "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"fieldname": "stage", "label": _("Stage"), "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160},
    {"fieldname": "currency", "label": _("Currency"), "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Currency", "hidden": 1},
    {"fieldname": "cost", "label": _("Cost"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "minimum", "label": _("Minimum Selling"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 130},
    {"fieldname": "sold", "label": _("Sold"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "gross_profit", "label": _("Gross Profit"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "gp_on_cost", "label": _("GP % on Cost"), "fieldtype": "Percent", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "invoiced", "label": _("Invoiced"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "collected", "label": _("Collected"), "fieldtype": "Currency", "options": "currency", "width": 120},
]
data = columns, rows
